title: About the Hidayah al-Qur'an Course Program
about: The Hidayah al-Qur'an Course Program is an educational program covering essential themes in the study of Ulum al-Qur'an (Quranic sciences) and usul tafsir (foundations of exegesis). This program is designed to provide a deep understanding of the Qur'an and assist participants in uncovering its profound meanings.
books_intro: The Hidayah al-Qur'an Course materials are structured based on the following books to be studied:
books: Introduction to the Science of Hidayah al-Qur'an
Principles and Rules of Hidayah al-Qur'an
The Science of Istinbath from the Qur'an
Scholars' Methods in Extracting Hidayah al-Qur'an
Application of Hidayah al-Qur'an in Life
about_ext: This program is conducted as an intensive learning experience free of charge (excluding the purchase of learning materials), and provides an international certificate with a flexible and comprehensive learning system.
system_items: Instruction uses Arabic as the medium of language.
The program is conducted face-to-face online via Zoom Meeting.
Materials are structured around 8 Hidayah al-Qur'an books studied progressively.
Each book is studied over ±28 sessions, with a frequency of 3 times per week, making the study duration per book approximately 2–2.5 months.
The duration of each session is 60–90 minutes.
requirements_items: Bachelor's Degree (S1) graduates from Islamic Studies or Arabic Language majors.
Pass an interview selection conducted by Markaz Tadarus Indonesia.
terms_items: Registered participants are advised to possess the learning books as support during the program.
Certificates will be awarded to participants who have completed the study of at least 1 book according to program provisions.
Participants must take part in learning actively and diligently throughout the program.
Participants who withdraw after the program starts must provide a contribution (infaq) according to program provisions.
schedule_items: Execution Days: One of the days in the range Monday–Friday, as well as Saturday and Sunday
Learning Time: Conducted after Fajr or after Isha prayers
register_desc: Click "REGISTER NOW" to proceed to the registration form (Google Form)
